basis: Leghemoglobin, O2 carrier in infected-cell cytoplasm; Lb RNAi abolishes N fixation (Ott et al. 2005 Curr Biol). Ye 2024 N-fixing zone c5 log2FC 3.06 (pct 0.97 vs 0.35). Marks the N-fixing stage, not young infected cells; ambient/spillover (in 84% of Ye outer-cortex c6 bins; Lbs 76-91%), so never use as a negative marker. Frank 2023 selected its bacteroid cells by Lb, so not independent. Gifu ID confirmed in UniProt Q3C1F7.

Leghemoglobin 2; as Lb1 (Ott et al. 2005 Curr Biol). Ye 2024 c5 3.09 (0.99 vs 0.46), the least specific Lb (91% of outer-cortex bins). N-fixing stage; ambient. Gifu ID confirmed in UniProt Q3C1F6 (which lists the same MG-20 ID as Lb1, so alt_id left empty).
Leghemoglobin 3; as Lb1 (Ott et al. 2005 Curr Biol). Ye 2024 c5 2.91 (0.98 vs 0.35); 76% of outer-cortex bins. N-fixing stage; ambient. Gifu ID confirmed in UniProt Q9FEP8.

Nodule-specific sulfate transporter needed for N fixation; sst1 is Fix- (Krusell et al. 2005 Plant Cell). Ye 2024 c5 2.28 (0.56 vs 0.12); Frank 2023 Lb+ bacteroid-containing cells 0.62 vs 0.018 (not the selection gene): two independent studies. Ye names the same ID LjSULTR2 in one sheet; paper annotation hit is UniProt Q0P7I2 (Sst1).

Homocitrate synthase that supplies the nitrogenase FeMo-cofactor; fen1 is Fix- with small infected cells (Hakoyama et al. 2009 Nature; review's 'Hakoyama 2012 PNAS' corrected). Ye 2024 c5 1.97 (0.58 vs 0.12), c9 1.74; Frank 2023 bacteroid-containing cells 0.14 vs 0. Two independent studies.

Vacuolar-iron-transporter-like integral membrane protein of infected cells; sen1 is Fix- (Hakoyama et al. 2012 Plant Cell Physiol). Frank 2023 bacteroid-containing cells 0.62 vs 0; Ye 2024 c9 1.24 (0.69 vs 0.09), c5 1.23 (0.33 vs 0.10). Added at collation (not in the Ye review list). Name/ID pairing from Frank VAL sheet; UniProt H3JSR8 has no Gifu ID.

ERF ortholog of MtEFD, which controls nodule differentiation and is expressed in the infection/infected zone (Vernie et al. 2008 Plant Cell). Ye 2024 differentiating-IZ c9 1.64 (0.49 vs 0.10), also c8 and mixture c12; Frank 2023 bacteroid-containing cells 3.6 log2FC (0.71 vs 0.04). Raised low->medium for two-study agreement. Young infected cells.

RING-finger E3 ligase required for symbiosis (Shimomura et al. 2006 Plant Cell Physiol). Ye 2024 c9 2.15 (0.74 vs 0.06); Frank 2023 bacteroid-containing cells 0.48 vs 0.018. Raised low->medium for two-study agreement. Paper annotation hit UniProt A0ZT53 (LjnsRING).

bHLH LHW paralog; promoter-GUS in nodule primordia and nodules, barely in roots (organ-level, Ye et al. 2024 Nat Commun); co-expressed with NIN in Ye IZ c9 1.61 (0.77 vs 0.13); Frank 2023 bacteroid-containing cells 0.48 vs 0.034. Raised low->medium. Also in primordia: young infected/infection-zone cells.

NIN-like protein that activates Lb promoters; promoter-GUS in nodules from 8 dpi (organ-level), nlp3 has fewer pink nodules (Ye et al. 2024 Nat Commun). Ye c5 2.22 (0.35 vs 0.05). Late/N-fixing stage of the central tissue; infected vs uninfected cells not resolved; not enriched in Frank 2023 cell selections.

Pectate lyase needed for infection-thread formation; promoter-GUS in infected root hairs (Xie et al. 2012 PNAS). Ye 2024 pre-infection c8 1.76 (0.49 vs 0.08). Frank 2023 infected cells were selected with NPL (not independent), but it is also in its Lb+ cells (0.57 vs 0.004). Paper annotation hit UniProt H2DL22 (NPL).

Exopolysaccharide receptor controlling infection; expressed in infection-thread and colonised primordium cells (Kawaharada et al. 2015 Nature; 2017 Nat Commun). Ye 2024 c8 0.95 (0.29 vs 0.06); Frank 2023 infected cells 0.22 vs 0.005. Two independent studies.

ERF target of CCaMK/CYCLOPS that controls rhizobial infection (Cerri et al. 2017 New Phytol). Ye 2024 c8 0.89 (0.28 vs 0.06); Frank 2023 infected cells 0.79 vs 0.17. Also in uninfected root hairs (Frank pct.2 0.17, trichoblasts): pair with NPL/EPR3.

U-box/WD40 E3 ligase; cerberus infection threads abort (Yano et al. 2009 Plant J; review's 'PNAS' corrected). Ye 2024 differentiating-IZ c9 1.21 (0.53 vs 0.05); Frank 2023 infected cells 0.18 vs 0.05. Gifu ID agrees in both papers' tables.

Ortholog of MtRPG, which directs infection-thread polar growth (Arrighi et al. 2008 PNAS). Ye 2024 c9 1.86 (0.95 vs 0.22); Frank 2023 infected cells 0.13 vs 0.004 and Lb+ cells 0.86 vs 0.004. Ortholog-level function (medium) raised to high for two-study agreement; persists into young infected cells.

RWP-RK TF required for infection and cortical cell division (Schauser et al. 1999 Nature). Ye 2024 c9 1.28 (0.79 vs 0.17), c8 0.64; Frank 2023 infected cells 0.25 vs 0.005, Lb+ cells 0.52 vs 0.006. Also in nodule primordia and young infected cells: not a type marker on its own.

NIN target needed for nodule primordium development and cortical cell division (Soyano et al. 2013 PLoS Genet). Broad in early Ye 2024 clusters (c8 1.48, 0.91 vs 0.36; c4 0.58; c3 0.67); Frank 2023 beta-CA1+ nodule cells 0.19 vs 0.015 and infected cells 0.80 vs 0.012. Also in infection-thread cells.

NOOT-BOP-COCH-LIKE1, needed to keep nodule identity (Magne et al. 2018 Plant J; MtNOOT, Couzigou et al. 2012 Plant Cell). Ye 2024 'meristem' c4 0.83 (0.31 vs 0.07); Frank 2023 nodule cells 0.28 vs 0.007 (named NOOT). Stage-restricted (medium) raised to high. Paper annotation hit UniProt G3LSH3 (NBCL).

SCARECROW ortholog; MtSHR-SCR specifies cortical cell fate for nodulation (Dong et al. 2021 Nature); LjSCR1 promoter-GUS in nodule meristems at 5-6 dpi (organ-level, Ye 2024); Ye c4 1.31 (0.31 vs 0.02). Conflict: Frank 2023 root endodermis cluster 24 (0.12-0.26 vs 0.02-0.04); require absence of CASP/MYB36 endodermis markers. Not raised.

B-type mitotic cyclin (G2/M; paper annotation CCNB1_SOYBN, UniProt I3S1U1 B-like cyclin). Ye 2024 'meristem' c4 1.18 (0.32 vs 0.05) and c8 0.88; Frank 2023 G2/M cluster 28 (labelled QC) 3.1 log2FC (0.70 vs 0.006). Two independent studies.
B-type cyclin (Frank's Arabidopsis best hit CYCB2;3), G2/M. Frank 2023 cluster 28 3.6 log2FC (0.73 vs 0.002); Ye 2024 c4 0.94 (0.25 vs 0.05).

E2 enzyme of APC/C-mediated cyclin degradation (Arabidopsis UBC19 hit); promoter-GUS reporter in Frank 2023 (Suppl. Fig 1b, called a QC marker but in dividing primordia), cluster 28 4.6 log2FC (0.87 vs 0.008); Ye 2024 c4 1.18 (0.38 vs 0.08), c8 0.81. Reporter + second study: medium raised to high.

Beta carbonic anhydrase; in situ in all cells of young nodules but only nodule inner cortex in mature nodules (Flemetakis et al. 2003 Biochim Biophys Acta; review's 'MPMI' corrected); promoter-GUS in primordia, then peripheral cortex AND uninfected cells (Wang et al. 2021 Int J Mol Sci); knockout has no symbiotic phenotype. Ye 2024 peripheral c7 2.40 (0.71 vs 0.21). Frank 2023 selected nodule cells by it. Not raised: stage-dependent and conflicting UC expression.

IDD C2H2 TF; GUS shows only absence from roots (Ye et al. 2024 Nat Commun). Ye peripheral c7 1.21 (0.27 vs 0.07), differentiating PT-2 with nodule vascular emergence; Frank 2023 beta-CA1+ nodule cells 0.51 vs 0.023. Two studies agree it is nodule-specific, but neither resolves inner cortex vs nodule vasculature, so not raised.
